title: Sentry User auth token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: "g" in the body, outside the lowercase hex Sentry's generator emits and alphabet: "z" in the body, outside the lowercase hex Sentry's generator emits. Twin of "Sentry User auth token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
